# Working with 2019 all the way through the next few blocks, subsequent years loaded to make the process easier once troubleshooting 2019 is complete.
# Load and inspect- per DoE, metadata is embedded, so that has to come out and rejoin a usable table.
```{r}
#install.packages("ncdf4") if needed

library(dplyr) #data format manipulation
library(ncdf4) #read nc files (3 and 4 type)
library(readr) #write out or read in tables
library(tibble) #creating tables

nc19 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2019.nc")
nc20 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2020.nc")
nc23 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2023.nc")
nc22 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2022.nc")
nc23 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2023.nc")
nc24 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2024.nc")
nc25 <- nc_open("data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2025.nc")

#glimpse(nc20)

```

# Arrays, arrays, arrays and vectors - must turn into usable tables.
```{r}

# 1. Station-level metadata
stations <- tibble(station_number = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "station_number")), station_name = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "Station")), latitude = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "Latitude")), longitude = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "Longitude")))

# 2. Profile-level metadata
profiles <- tibble(profile_index = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "profile_index")), station_number = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "station_index")), field_date = as.Date(as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "FieldDate")), origin = "1970-01-01"))

# 3. Observation-level measurements
observations <- tibble(
  profile_index = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "obs_index")),
  depth_m = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "Depth")),

  temperature = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "Temp")),
  salinity = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "Salinity")),
  dissolved_oxygen = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "DOAdjusted")),

  nitrate = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "NO3")),
  nitrite = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "NO2")),
  ammonium = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "NH4")),
  phosphate = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "PO4")),
  silicate = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc20, "SiOH4"))
)

# 4. Join measurements to profiles and stations
water_quality19 <- observations %>%
  left_join(
    profiles,
    by = "profile_index",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stations,
    by = "station_number",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

nc_close(nc20)

# Verify resulting dataset
#glimpse(water_quality19)

write_csv(water_quality19, "data/interim/water_quality19.csv")


```

# Filter any depths beyond where mussel ropes extend for anything that isn't a nutrient
```{r}

# Depth-appropriate abiotic measurements
abiotic_rope19 <- water_quality19 %>%
  filter(between(depth_m, 0, 13)) %>%
  select(
    profile_index,
    station_number,
    station_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    depth_m,
    temperature,
    salinity,
    dissolved_oxygen
  )

# Nutrients at all sampled depths
nutrients19 <- water_quality19 %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      c(nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate, silicate),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    profile_index,
    station_number,
    station_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    depth_m,
    nitrate,
    nitrite,
    ammonium,
    phosphate,
    silicate
  )

write_csv(abiotic_rope19, "data/working/abiotic_rope_2019.csv")
write_csv(nutrients19, "data/working/nutrients_2019.csv")

```

# Combine each data set so that 2019 - 2025 water quality and 2019 - 2025 nutrients are two compplete tables.
